name: hcapp_gdprDelete
description: Anonymises the calling user's Hasher record in response to a GDPR deletion request. Does NOT delete the record — instead overwrites PII fields with dummy values and sets Removed=1. Only operates if the user is not already removed. Returns 'success' or 'failed' string. Uses non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: DeletionResult
rowsets.description: Always returned on successful auth. Single row.

columns.name: result
columns.description: 'success' if the UPDATE affected 1 row (user was not already removed), 'failed' if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 (already removed or not found).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET HomeKennelId=NULL, MotherKennelId=NULL, SupportCode='*'+old, ResetCode='*'+old, QR_code='*'+old, HashName='Deleted User', FirstName='Deleted', LastName='User', Email=ResetCode+'@harriercentral.com', Photo='bundle://avatar-0', FacebookId=NULL, ThirdPartyUserId=NULL, ThirdPartyAccessToken=NULL, ThirdPartyEmail=NULL, ThirdPartyLoginType='none', Description=NULL, HomeLatitude=NULL, HomeLongitude=NULL, HomeGeolocation=NULL, Removed=1, updatedAt=getdate(), SingleSignOnId=NULL, SingleSignOnType=NULL, IsBetaTester=0 WHERE Removed=0

codeSmells.detail: Error rowsets use Pascal-cased (ErrorType, ErrorTitle, ErrorDescription) with no errorId or errorProc.
'success'/'failed' in the result column. Caller must parse string.

codeSmells.issue: Email set to ResetCode + '@harriercentral.com' — uses an already-prefixed code
codeSmells.detail: At time of deletion, SupportCode and ResetCode are prefixed with '*'. The email is set from the raw ResetCode (without the '*') read at UPDATE time. This is slightly inconsistent with the SupportCode/ResetCode being prefixed.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the anonymization pattern without legal review
